commits.message: Initial commit

Add unit tests for `isArray`, `isArrayBuffer`, `isBoolean`, `isBuffer`, `isDate`, `isElement`, `isError`, `isFinite`, `isFunction`, `isInteger`, `isMap`, `isNaN`, `isNil`, `isNull`, `isNumber`, `isObject`, `isObjectLike`, `isPlainObject`, `isRegExp`, `isSet`, `isString` utils in `utilsLang`.
Add `aFirst` and `aLast` utility functions with tests. Replace `lodash` usage across modules (`AMenu`, `ATable`, `ASlider`, `AGroupButtonDropdown`, `utils`) to optimize array operations.
Add `PageVerticalAlign` section with localized translations and examples (`Table`). Include supporting APIs (composition, HTML, JS) and menu integration.
Add `PageScreenreader` section with localized translations and examples (`Table`). Include supporting APIs (composition, HTML, JS) and menu integration.

Add `PageFloat` section with localized translations and examples (`Table`). Include supporting APIs (composition, HTML, JS) and menu integration.
Add `PageDisplay` section with localized translations and examples (`Basic`, `Breakpoints`). Include supporting APIs (composition, HTML, JS) and menu integration.
Add `breakpoints` constant for global use in documentation
Add localized translations for `_TXT_BREAKPOINT_VALUE_` across all supported languages
Add `PagePosition` section with localized translations and examples (`Types`, `Offsets`, `Translate`). Include supporting APIs (composition, HTML, JS) and menu integration.
Refactor `PageBadgeBasic` and `PageBadgeRounded` sections to use table-based examples with `TableAPI`. Improve localization by adding new translations for badge styles across all supported languages.
Add localized translations for `PageColors` section descriptions and labels across all supported languages.
Add `PageColors` section with localized translations and examples (`Text`, `Background`). Include supporting APIs (composition, HTML, JS) and menu integration.
Add localized translations for `_TXT_EXAMPLE_`, `_TXT_CLASS_`, and `_TXT_COLOR_` across all supported languages
Add `inherit` styles for color and background-color classes in SCSS
Add `PageSpacing` section with localized translations and examples (`Config`, `HTML`, `Class Table`). Introduce supporting APIs (composition, SCSS, HTML) and styles.
Add `PageColumns` section with localized translations and examples (`Basic`, `Count`, `Gap`, `Offset`, `Breakpoints`) and supporting APIs (composition, HTML, JS).
Version 2.45.0
Replace `Short` pagination mode with dynamic `Mode` pagination, allowing users to switch between `short` and `normal` layouts. Update associated logic, examples, and translations.
Add `PagePaginationPages` component with localized translations, examples (`Basic`, `Disabled`, `MaxPages`, `Short`), and supporting APIs (composition, HTML, JS).
Refactor SCSS structure in `APagination` components to use shared `a_pagination_vars` class for styling consistency, update associated classes in `APaginationPages` and `APaginationCountPerPage`.
Rename `countAllRows` to `totalCount` across pagination components, update relevant logic, props, examples, and translations for consistency. Add `PagePaginationPages` route and translations.
Export `APaginationPages` component from `index.js`.
Update Arabic translation for `totalCount` description in `APagination` component for consistency
Rename `countAllRows` to `totalCount` across `APagination` components and update related logic, props, and translations for clarity and consistency.
Rename `paginationMaxItems` to `maxPages` in `APaginationPages` and update related logic for clarity and consistency.
Add `TextsAPI` to enhance text customization and internationalization in `APaginationPages`
Refactor conditional rendering in `APaginationPages` to improve readability and maintain consistency.
Add `PagePaginationMaxPages` component with example and localized translations
Simplify `PagePaginationLimitsPerPage` component logic by replacing object-based `limitsPerPageOptions` with a simple array and removing unnecessary computed properties.
Add `PagePaginationLimitsPerPage` component with example and localized translations
Remove `totalRowsCount` prop and related references in favor of `countAllRows`.
Add `PagePaginationDisabled` component with example and internationalized support
Update `APagination` markup and styles for improved structure and consistency
Add `AlohaPaginationItems` component and integrate it with `PagePaginationBasic`
Remove `hasRows` prop from `APagination` and related logic for simplification.
Add `APagination` documentation with localized translations and examples.
Replace default string values with `null` in `ATabsContent` and `ATabsTab` render methods for consistency.

Wrap `textSelectAll` and `textDeselectAll` in `ATranslation` for improved localization support in `ASelect`.

Fix `isActionColumnVisible` reference in `SimpleTableAPI` to ensure correct return logic.

Fix `isActionIconVisible` initialization in `SimpleTableAPI` to correctly reference its prop.

Export `DOMPurify` from `utils.js` for enhanced modularity and clarify `isomorphic-dompurify` usage.

Version 2.39.4
Refactor `ATableTd`: simplify ternary expressions for readability and update `ATranslation` prop from `text` to `html`.
Version 2.39.3
CSS Replace `color-adjust` to `print-color-adjust`
Version 2.39.1
Update `getRemPx` in `ARemPxAPI`: replace `defaultRemPx.value` with static `16` for non-browser environments.
Version 2.39.0

Refactor mounting logic: introduce `isMounted` state and move `addPopperContainerInBody` calls into `onMounted` lifecycle hook across components for consistent initialization timing. Adjust render methods to account for `isMounted` state.

Integrate `isBrowser` checks into `AMobileAPI`, `ANotification`, `AMenu`, `APageTabTitleAPI`, and `ARemPxAPI` to ensure compatibility with non-browser environments. Update lifecycle hooks for proper rendering and initialization timing.
Refactor popper initialization: move `addPopperContainerInBody` calls into `onMounted` lifecycle hook in `ATooltip`, `ADropdown`, and `ASelect` for proper mounting timing.
Integrate `isBrowser` checks into `AMobilePlugin` and `ARemPxPlugin` to ensure compatibility with non-browser environments.
Refactor browser environment checks: integrate `isBrowser` utility into `autosize`, `utils`, and `utilsDOM` to improve maintainability and consistency.
Add `isBrowser` utility function: detect browser environment and export through `index.js`.
Version 2.35.1
Enhance `ASlider`'s `DataAPI`: refine step value handling with decimal precision and update computed data to ensure accurate values using `toFixed`.
Version 2.35.0

Add `PageSliderVertical` example: update `ASlider`'s `StopsAPI` and styles for vertical slider support, integrate new example into documentation with pug template, JavaScript content, and i18n keys, and fix typo in `StopsAPI` key.

Add `PageSliderStops` example: update `ASlider`'s `StopsAPI` with improved stop rendering using lodash's `forEach` and computed positions, update slider styles with new variables for stop customization, and integrate new example into documentation with related i18n keys, pug template, and JavaScript content.

Refactor `ASlider` component: extract `AttributesAPI` and `LabelAPI` for improved modularity, enhance dragging and hovering states with separate logic for each slider handle, update styles for better visual feedback, and integrate focus management for accessibility improvements.

Add aria attributes support to `ASlider`: implement `AriaAttributesAPI` for improved accessibility, integrate i18n for ARIA labels, update props for customizable accessibility, and enhance templates with new attributes and roles.

Refactor `ASlider` component: extract `TitleAPI` from `SliderAPI` for modularity, remove tooltip handling, replace `showTooltip` with `title` and `isTitleHtml` props for flexibility, and update related imports, references, and usage in `DragAndDropAPI` and templates.

Add `PageSliderData` example: integrate new example into `PageSlider`, enhance `ASlider`'s `DataAPI` with unique data handling using `uniqBy`, and update documentation with related i18n keys, pug template, and JavaScript content.

Enhance `PageSliderMinMax` with step support: update sliders to include `step` property, adjust i18n keys, and improve `ASlider`'s `DataAPI` for enhanced data handling with computed `dataFromPropsData`.

Refactor `ASlider` component: extract `DragAndDropAPI` and `StylesAPI` from `SliderAPI` for improved modularity, update related imports and references, enhance dragging functionality with tooltip visibility and event listeners, and improve documentation with corrected `PageSliderMinMax` example.

Refactor `ASlider` component: extract `DataAPI` and `MarksAPI` from `SliderAPI` for improved modularity, update related imports and references, enhance data handling, and refactor styles with computed positions for better accuracy.
Docs: `PageSliderMinMax`
Refactor `ASlider` component: extract `StopsAPI` from `SliderAPI` for improved modularity and maintainability, and update related imports and references.

Add `PageSliderRange` example with composition API usage, update `PageSlider` component to include new example, improve `ASlider` tooltip handling with `isNumber` check, update slider labels with i18n keys, and enhance documentation with related APIs, pug templates, and JavaScript content.

Add `PageSliderLabelDescription` example with composition API usage, update `PageSlider` component to include new example, and enhance documentation with related APIs, pug template, and JavaScript content.

Add `PageSliderErrors` example with composition API usage, update `PageSlider` component to include new example, and enhance documentation with related APIs, pug template, JavaScript content, and SCSS styles for error handling support.
Add `PageSliderHelpText` example with composition API usage, update `PageSlider` component to include new example, and enhance documentation with related APIs, pug template, and JavaScript content.
Add `PageSliderChange` example with composition API usage, update `PageSlider` component to include new example, and enhance documentation with related APIs, pug template, and JavaScript content.
Refactor `PageSliderBasic` examples: consolidate models into a single `model` ref, update slider labels with i18n keys, and simplify documentation with revised composition and template APIs.
Refactor `ASlider` component: remove unused `ModelAPI`, restructure `SliderAPI` for modularity, and update SCSS styles with CSS variables for improved customization and maintainability.
ASlider: initial implementation with composition API and styles
Version 2.34.0
Add gap utilities for spacing, including `.a_gap_*`, `.a_gap_x_*`, and `.a_gap_y_*` classes based on `$a_spacing_values`.
Migrate `ADatepicker` localization to JSON-based i18n files, remove hardcoded language definitions, and refactor related APIs for improved modularity and maintainability.

Refactor `APanelMonth` component to use composition API, modularize logic into `MonthsAPI`, `SelectAPI`, `FocusAPI`, `FocusActiveAPI`, and `PanelAPI` modules, and simplify methods and computed properties for improved maintainability.
Refactor `APanelYearItem` component to use composition API, extract logic into `AttributesAPI` and `SelectAPI` modules, and simplify methods and computed properties for improved maintainability.

Add `startDate` and `focusStartDate` props to `ADatepicker` and `ADatepickerCalendarPanel` components, refactor calendar initialization logic into `CalendarAPI`, and enhance documentation with new examples and i18n updates.
Refactor `APanelDate` component to use composition API, extract related logic into modular files, and simplify methods and computed properties for improved maintainability.
Introduce maxDate and minDate props for ADatepicker
Version 2.33.1
Add `alertParentClassLocal` to `AAlert` component, update related composition API logic, and enhance documentation with new examples for `remove-alert-on-close`.
